name: approveit
description: Build, run and analyze approval workflows. Approveit connects ChatGPT to your organization's approval workflows, within the permissions of the signed-in Approveit user.

interface.longDescription:
Approveit connects ChatGPT to your organization's approval workflows. ChatGPT can build and configure workflows, submit approval requests, record approve or reject decisions, and retrieve and analyze approval data, all within the permissions of the signed-in Approveit user.

People stay in the loop. Approvers receive and act on requests in Slack, Microsoft Teams, email or the Approveit web app, and every action taken through ChatGPT is recorded in the request's audit trail under the connected user's name.

With Approveit in ChatGPT, you can:

• Build workflows with custom fields, multi-step and conditional routing, reminders and escalations
• Submit requests through existing workflows
• See what's waiting on you, then approve or reject with a comment
• Look up request status and approval history, including who decided, when and why
• Analyze approval activity, including request volume, approval time and rejection reasons

Common workflows include purchase requests, invoice and bill approvals, deal desk and discount approvals, vendor onboarding, contract review, access requests, HR and operations requests, and human sign-off for AI agents.

Approveit records and manages approval decisions. It does not transfer money or execute payments. Approveit can connect approval workflows with systems including NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, Salesforce, Jira, Ramp, DocuSign and other business applications. Data is synced according to your existing Approveit workspace and integration settings.

Requires an Approveit account. Approveit is SOC 2 Type II compliant.

defaultPrompt: What approval requests are waiting on me?
Submit a purchase order for 3 monitors at 420 USD each.
Analyze our approval activity: volume and average approval time.

positive.description: Admin explores workflow templates before building a purchase approval workflow. Read-only: nothing is created.
positive.prompt: I want to set up a purchase approval workflow in Approveit. What templates are there, and what would the purchase order one include?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the available workflow templates, then describes the purchase order template: its fields and its approval steps. No workflow is created unless the user explicitly asks for one.

positive.description: Requestor submits a purchase order through an existing workflow, with a confirmation step before anything is sent.
positive.prompt: Submit a purchase order for 3 monitors at 420 USD each.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the purchase order workflow, fills its fields from the prompt, asks for any required value that is missing, and shows a preview of the request and its approvers. Nothing is submitted until the user confirms. After confirmation it returns the new request's reference (for example AR-1042) and a link to open it in Approveit.

positive.description: Approver checks their queue and approves a request with a comment. The decision is recorded only after explicit confirmation.
positive.prompt: What's waiting on my approval in Approveit? Approve the oldest one with the comment "Within budget".
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the requests where the connected user is the current pending approver, newest first, with reference, title and requestor. For the oldest one it shows a preview of the approval and the comment, and asks the user to confirm. Nothing is recorded until the user confirms. After confirmation it reports the request's updated status.

positive.description: Requestor looks up the status and approval history of their most recent request. Read-only.
positive.prompt: What's the status of the last request I submitted in Approveit, and who has approved it so far?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the connected user's most recent request and returns its status, submitted field values, each approver with their decision and when it was made, and a link to open it in Approveit. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Manager analyzes approval activity across the workspace. Read-only aggregate.
positive.prompt: How many approval requests were submitted in Approveit each month this year, and how many of them were rejected?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the number of requests submitted per month this year and the breakdown by status, including how many were rejected, computed across the requests the connected user can see. If the data is limited or truncated, says so rather than presenting a partial result as complete.

negative.description: Payment execution is out of scope. Approveit records approval decisions and does not move money, so ChatGPT should say it cannot make payments and must not claim one was made. At most it offers to look up or approve the related request.
negative.prompt: Pay the Dell invoice from our company bank account.

negative.description: Unrelated question that shares the word "approval". No Approveit tool should be called; ChatGPT answers from general knowledge or web search.
negative.prompt: What's the US president's current approval rating?

negative.description: Access outside the connected workspace. The connection acts as one user in one workspace, so ChatGPT should say it can only see the connected workspace and must not present that workspace's data as another company's.
negative.prompt: Show me the pending approval requests in Acme Corp's Approveit workspace.
